Ecgberht — icon suggestions

From Jumper (2026-07-24) · spelling Ecgberht · English king of Wessex (d. 839) · steward skill mark, not fantasy cosplay

Kill-filter consensus: do not ship a generic gold crown on black. Generate four habit silhouettes; pass/fail at 16×16 / 32×32 first; dual chrome = same path, light vs dark; pick one production mark. No lettering, runes, faces, or multi-charge heraldry in the glyph.

H1 · recommended Seal-ring

Why Ecgberht: steward authenticates the work (charter / seal of office), not “king as character.”

  • Annular mass + one small regalia cut
  • Reads as authority without RPG crown tray collision

H2 Coin-die mass

Why: struck continuous silhouette — “authority as mass,” coin of the realm feel without text.

  • One continuous disk + simple profile cut
  • Risk: can look like any coin/crypto icon if too generic

H3 · recommended Seat / void

Why: negative space that holds the campaign — maps to Face/Strip stewardship better than jewelry.

  • Architectural throne/seat outline, strong void
  • Risk: can read as furniture/app-window if not sharp enough

H4 Seax diagonal

Why: Anglo-Saxon tool of office (single diagonal mass) — historical, not multi-sword heraldry.

  • One cleavage / blade mass only
  • Risk: security / VPN / game weapon tray confusion — needs kill-test

Jumper survivors: (1) thin-section / habit-lock protocol · (2) punchcutting / dual-impression protocol — same production law, different metaphors.
